_comment: MTG_EDF_AURA_RANGE_HOSTS (part 2c of the USER-approved EDF cast-order package, 2026-10-14; docs/design/edf-cast-order-2026-10-14.md). Seed 11311458 gi 1457 (the A/B's d3 cell), turn 3: Conservatory and Brushland + Trace of Abundance in play, hand [Eldrazi Displacer, Cloud of Faeries, Eladamri's Call, Overgrowth, Conservatory, Yavimaya Coast]. The kill: drop the Coast, Overgrowth ON THE COAST paid by Conservatory + Brushland/Trace, the Coast taps {U}{G}{G} for Cloud with one to spare, Cloud untaps Brushland and the Coast, the Displacer resolves with three floating for the first blink. The plan dedup folds land-Aura host variants to the class's first member; part 2 (the range) made the Overgrowth-on-CONSERVATORY variant payable Cloud-first, it sorted first (host 1 < host 9) and the fold dropped the Coast variant, so no win at any budget (--depth 8 --budget-ms 0 included). 2c keeps the class's first rank-order member beside its first moved one. MTG_EDF_AURA_RANGE_HOSTS=0: no win; MTG_EDF_AURA_RANGE=0: win (the Conservatory variant is unpayable, the Coast one is the only member).
